title: The ES Editions PDF separates the TAXII summary heading from its qualification
problem: The first TAXII question is printed at the foot of page 2 and its decision qualification begins on page 3 in both themes of the checked baseline.

deployments: Native PDF, default and Cisco theme
exclusions: Presentation-only. The detailed TAXII question and numbered citations remain readable. No vendor protocol, edition, entitlement or compatibility inference.

impact.customerScenario: Read the compact decision context in a printed ES Editions report.
impact.consequence: A page break separates a question from its qualification, requiring the reader to turn the page.

confidence.rationale: Both retained PDFs independently reproduce the same first-occurrence split. The detailed source question is intact.

lifecycle.reason: Retain the verified historical output observation. Candidate and production verification are tracked separately.

evidence.section: Retained editions-default and editions-cisco report PDFs, pages 2–3
evidence.statement: First TAXII question heading and its qualification split in both themes. The occurrence-specific regression fails on both retained baseline PDFs.
